name: neon-tech-visuals
description: Create ray-traced-style abstract neon tech videos purely from code: GLSL ray marching with glossy reflections, camera-driven motion blur, fisheye lens, chromatic aberration, bloom, and an original BPM-synced electronic soundtrack synthesized with numpy, rendered to MP4. Ships tunnel / circuit city / data core scenes and supports custom scenes. No generative image or video AI.
